subject: Financial Management and Strategic Management
paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
9.
Identify the initial strategy to gain competitive advantage adopted by Alex
Motor Company.
(A)  Growth strategy emphasizing strong and fuel-efficient vehicles.
(B)  Focused cost leadership strategy emphasizing fuel efficiency and easy
maintenance.
(C)  Focused differentiation strategy emphasizing customized commercial
vehicles, easy maintenance and fuel efficiency rather than mass
production.
(D)  Expansion strategy emphasizing customized vehicles and mass
production.
(2 Marks)
